behavior: Repository scope grants resolve the selected checkout through the shared registered Git worktree verifier.
Nested linked worktrees retain branch, common-directory, manifest, workspace, and checkout identities.
Grants record the exact checkout path and admit narrow worktree claims; other branches in independent worktrees coexist.
Composition revalidates the same checkout and accepts either a matching current worktree claim or a legacy repository-wide claim.
Owner-recovered worktree claims require canonical owner and target scope, exact Store identity, and recovery provenance; bounded untracked campaign evidence is preserved and rechecked.
Entry selection resumes the exact same campaign for each of five unrelated registered checkout contexts; a duplicate same-checkout session remains ambiguous.

limitations: The owner-approved Control scope grant for mncs-language remains unavailable in the Compiler campaign.
Environment merge and publish authority is escalation-required; this revision is retained on its campaign branch.

verification.resource_measurements: not collected; these targeted tests exercise Git and Store lifecycle behavior rather than compiler builds
static_checks: python3 -m ruff check --select I mncs_env/sessions.py tests/test_authority_scope_grants.py tests/test_entry.py
